page.title: Backups
page.subtitle: Files and databases from your servers — to a local directory or S3, on a schedule.
page.decryptInfo: Encrypted archives (age) are decrypted with {{command}}: enter the job's passphrase, or add -i key.txt for jobs encrypted to an age key. The panel never shows a stored passphrase and cannot decrypt age-key archives itself.
